One gap found while verifying, and it is app wide rather than a rotation concern, so it is filed separately rather than reopened here: the in-app calm the visuals preference never reaches CSS, so the affordance keeps breathing for a walker who asked for calm.

Merged as PR 86. useReduceVisualsAttribute publishes the effective preference as data-motion on the document element; both stylesheets key off it, with the media queries scoped to :root:not([data-motion]) for the frames before the effect runs. Three e2e tests, each verified to fail with the fix disabled while all five existing reduce-visuals specs still passed.
